text_block_list.text:
It was during one of our
regular physical measurements—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Just as I thought!
It is exactly as I expected!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Um, it's about my weight, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, even after eating all those sweets,
my weight hasn't increased at all...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And that's without the excessive training she used to do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is surely because she is receiving proper nutrition
based on the meal plan you provided, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Allow me to thank you once again for your meticulous guidance,
Trainer."

Mejiro McQueen and I renewed our determination
to keep doing our best together.
